8CSG: The Fascinating and Beauteous Beloved is the Giver of support to all.

I have won over the invaluable human life and that I will not lose, again.

I have obtained God, the treasure of everything, whose discourse is ineffable.

Becoming illustrious in God's court I shall wave my arm in joy.

Whatever is seen, that goes not with the man.
8VXT: The foolish, faithless cynics are attached - they waste away and die. ||2||
Attached therewith the foolish mammon-worshipper putrefies and dies.
AQVT: The Name of the Fascinating Lord is all-pervading forever.
The Name of the Fascinating Lord is ever pervading.
BZ80: Among millions, how rare is that Gurmukh who attains the Name. ||3||
Among million, there is hardly one, who through the Guru, attains to the Name.
71GR: Greet the Lord's Saints humbly, with deep respect.
Make obeisance, obeisance, to God's Saints.
0RYS: You shall obtain the nine treasures, and receive infinite peace. ||4||
Thus shall you receive nine treasures and infinite peace.
XU79: With your eyes, behold the holy people;
with yours eyes, behold the holy men.
YUX3: in your heart, sing the treasure of the Naam. ||5||
Within your mind, sing the praise of the Name-treasure.
SBXG: Abandon sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
Abandon lust, wrath, avarice and worldly love.

Thus be rid of both birth and death.
TXES: Pain and darkness shall depart from your home,
Distress and darkness shall depart from your home,
WKC6: when the Guru implants spiritual wisdom within you, and lights that lamp. ||7||
when, within you, the Guru implants wisdom and lits the Divine lamp.
R1FX: One who serves the Lord crosses over to the other side.

JXM0: O servant Nanak, the Gurmukh saves the world. ||8||1||13||
Through the Guru, O slave Nanak, the entire world is saved.
MT9P: Dwelling upon the Lord, Har, Har, and the Guru, the Guru, my doubts have been dispelled.
Meditating on God's Name and the Great Guru, my doubts are dispelled.
3KKG: My mind has obtained all comforts. ||1||Pause||
My soul has obtained all the comforts. Pause.

On me, smouldering and burning, the Guru has sprinkled water the Guru is cool like Sandal.

My darkness of ignorance is dispelled, with the Guru's lamp of Divine Knowledge.

The sea of fire is deep, embarking on the Name boat, the Saints have ferried me across.
W6BJ: I have no good karma; I have no Dharmic faith or purity. But God has taken me by the arm, and made me His own. ||4||
In me there is no Good deed, faith and piety. Taking me by the arm, the Lord has owned me.
FRBT: The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain, the Lover of His Saints - these are the Names of the Lord. ||5||
The Destroyer of fear, the Dispeller of pain and the Lover of His Saints, are the Names of God.
E63A: He is the Master of the masterless, Merciful to the meek, All-powerful, the Support of His Saints. ||6||
God is the Master of the Masterless, Merciful to the meek, Omnipotent and the support of his Saints.
W0T4: I am worthless - I offer this prayer, O my Lord King: "Please, grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan." ||7||
I, virtueless, Make a supplication, O Sovereign Lord, "Bless me with Yours Sight".
3SE0: Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O my Lord and Master; Your servant has come to Your Door. ||8||2||14||
Nanak is under Yours protection, O Lord. Your servant has come and fallen at Yours door.

KL06: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Chhant, First Mehl:

For her decorations, sweet dainties, sensuous revelments and victuals are all false and of no account.
ESUB: Intoxicated with the wine of youthful pride, she has been ruined, and her breasts no longer yield milk.
Intoxicated with the wine of youth's pride, she is ruined Like the extracted milk, not returning to teats, she will have no further opportunity.

Nanak, the bride meets her Consort, when He causes her to meet Him, and without Him no sleep comes to her.
LJNT: The bride is dishonored without her Beloved Husband Lord.
The bride is unhonoured without her Beloved Master.
8X45: How can she find peace, without enshrining Him in her heart?
How can she attain peace, without embracing Him to her heart?
2J1A: Without her Husband, her home is not worth living in; go and ask your sisters and companions.
Without the Groom the home is not worth living in. Ask your mates and companions.
MTVQ: Without Naam, the Name of the Lord, there is no love and affection; but with her True Lord, she abides in peace.

Come my mates and companions let us enjoy our Beloved Husband.

69LJ: The Guru has shown me the True Word of the Shabad. The self-willed manmukhs will regret and repent.
The True Word, the Guru has shown me. The apostates shall repent.
JHY6: My wandering mind became steady, when I recognized the True One.
My roaming mind became steady when I recognised the True One.
LDA7: The Teachings of Truth are forever new; the love of the Shabad is forever fresh.
The understanding of the True One is ever new and ever fresh is the love of the True Name.

Nanak, from True Lord's gracious glance, peace is obtained. Meet Him, My mates and friends.
940E: My desire has been fulfilled - my Friend has come to my home.
My desire has been fulfilled and my Friend has come to my home.
8W62: At the Union of husband and wife, the songs of rejoicing were sung.
At the union of Husband and wife a song of rejoicing was sung.
U27R: Singing the songs of joyful praise and love to Him, the soul-bride's mind is thrilled and delighted.
By singing the joyful songs, in the praise and love of the Groom, bride's soul is delighted and pleased.
LVHF: My friends are happy, and my enemies are unhappy; meditating on the True Lord, the true profit is obtained.
The friends are happy and the enemies unhappy. By meditating in the True One, true profit is gained,
0P3X: With her palms pressed together, the soul-bride prays, that she may remain immersed in the Love of her Lord, night and day.
With clasped hands, the wife prays that night and say she may remain immersed in her Lord's love.
1XEB: O Nanak, the Husband Lord and the soul-bride revel together; my desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||
Nanak my desire is fulfilled now the Beloved and His consort revel together.

0EC3: Hear me, O my Dear Husband God - I am all alone in the wilderness.
Hear O my Venerable Lord Spouse I am all alone in the wilderness.

O my Self-dependent Lord Spouse, how can I be comforted without You?
KK11: The soul-bride cannot live without her Husband; the night is so painful for her.
The wife cannot live without her Groom. Very painful is the nigh for her.
XUP3: Sleep does not come. I am in love with my Beloved. Please, listen to my prayer!
I get no sleep, my Beloved is pleasing to me. O my Husband, hear You my prayer.
MCX3: Other than my Beloved, no one cares for me; I cry all alone in the wilderness.
Without You, O my Beloved, none takes care of me. I bewail all alone in wilderness.
GE51: O Nanak, the bride meets Him when He causes her to meet Him; without her Beloved, she suffers in pain. ||1||
Nanak, without her Love, the bride suffers anguish, she meets Him only when He causes her to meet.
CZ28: She is separated from her Husband Lord - who can unite her with Him?
The one deserted by the Consort who can unite her with her Lord?
UF2W: Tasting His Love, she meets Him, through the Beautiful Word of His Shabad.
Relishing Lord's love and the beauteous Name. She meets her sire Spouse.
A43Q: Adorned with the Shabad, she obtains her Husband, and her body is illuminated with the lamp of spiritual wisdom.
When the bride is adorned with the Name, then does she obtain her Spouse and her body is illumined with the lamp of Divine Knowledge.
CMC3: Listen, O my friends and companions - she who is at peace dwells upon the True Lord and His True Praises.
Hearken, O my friendly comrade by remembering the True Lord and the True One's praises, the wife becomes comfortable.

How can the noose round her neck be united without the most darling Guru?

How can the giving of alms and donations and many ablutions. Wash off the filth of the heart?

True is Your Name, O reverend Lord and true is the meditation of the Name.

Sweet is The business of Your Name. The Saints earn the profit night and day.

Without this I can think of no other merchandise. Repeat God's Name every moment.

Through True Lord's grace and perfect destiny the mortal assays such an account and obtains the Lord.

Nanak, the bride who has the necklace of Lord's Name around her neck is the beloved of her spouse.
UNW0: The soul-bride who is without her beloved Husband is all alone.
Solitary is the wife without her Beloved Husband.
3QDW: She is cheated by the love of duality, without the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Without the effectual humans of the Guru she is the cheated by another's Love.

When she was ruined by falsehood then was she abandoned by the groom. The bride obtains not Lord's presence.

She who is imbued with Gurbani, gets intoxicated with Lord's love and night and day, remains absorbed in Him.

The Venerable Lord blends with Himself the wife, who, ever, remains steeped in His Love.

If God unites only then do we meet him. Without God who can cause us to meet Him.?

Without our beloved Guru who can dispel our doubt?

Through the Guru, the doubt is dispelled this is the way to meet God, O my mother and like this the bride attains peace.
QGRB: Without serving the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. Without the Guru, the Way is not found.
Sans Guru's service, there is pitch darkness. Without the Guru the way is not found.
3DXR: That wife who is intuitively imbued with the color of His Love, contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The wife who is imbued with the Divine dye and is absorbed in the love of the Lord, dwells on the Guru's hymns.

Nanak, by enshrining love for the Beloved Guru the bride has found God, as her Groom.

Without my Husband, I am greatly dishonoured. How can I live without my Master, O my Mother?
HT4K: Without my Husband, sleep does not come, and my body is not adorned with my bridal dress.
Without my Spouse I get no sleep and dress bedecks not my body.
35Y1: The bridal dress looks beautiful upon my body, when I am pleasing to my Husband Lord. Following the Guru's Teachings, my consciousness is focused on Him.
Oh my body the clothes look beautiful when I become pleasing to my Spouse. By Guru's instruction my soul is attuned to Him.
CPD2: I become His happy soul-bride forever, when I serve the True Guru; I sit in the Lap of the Guru.
If she serve the True Guru, for ever, she becomes a happy wife and sits into the Guru's lap.

Nanak, the bride becomes sweet to her Husband when she sings the praises of God.

With her Beloved, the bride enjoys His love.

Imbued with His live day and night, she dwells on Guru's hymns.

She reflects on Gurbani stills her ego and in this way meets her Beloved.
DP14: She is the happy soul-bride of her Lord, who is forever imbued with the Love of the True Name of her Beloved.
The wife who is ever imbued in the love of the sweet True Name is her Spouse's favourite.

By abiding in the society of our Guru, we grasp the Name Nectar and kill and cast away our duality.

Nanak finding God as her Groom the bride has forgotten all her discomforts.
25F7: The soul-bride has forgotten her Husband Lord, because of love and emotional attachment to Maya.

She who drives away her falsehood and acts upon Guru's instruction, loses not her life in gamble.

Nanak the bride who has the support of the True Name merges into the Lord.

Meet me I my honourable Beloved, Without You I am greatly dishonoured.
8QP2: Sleep does not come to my eyes, and I have no desire for food or water.
In my eyes there is no sleep and for food and water I have no relish.
G1YW: I have no desire for food or water, and I am dying from the pain of separation. Without my Husband Lord, how can I find peace?
I love not food and water and I am dying of the sorrow of His separation. Without the Darling Husband, how can peace be obtained.?

I pray to the Guru if it pleases him, he may unite me with himself in any way he can unite.
A781: The Giver of peace has united me with Himself; He Himself has come to my home to meet me.
Lord, the Giver of Peace has united me with Himself. He Himself has come home to meet me.
GSWA: O Nanak, the soul-bride is forever the Lord's favorite wife; her Husband Lord does not die, and He shall never leave. ||4||2||
Nanak, such a bride is ever her Spouse's favourite. The Beloved neither dies nor parts company.

The bride is pierced through with God's elixir and Divine serene temper.

The Heart Enticer has captivated her and her duality has easily been annulled.

This body is filled up to the fullest with falsehood and deception and commits sins.

Nanak the bride who sheds her self-conceit from within becomes dear to her Beloved.

The bride has found her Darling Lord, through the love and affection of the Guru.

By clapping the Guru to her heart and mind she peacefully sleeps during the night.

By enshrining the Guru in the mind night and day, she meets her Beloved and her anguishes depart.

Within her heart-mansion, the bride enjoys her Bridegroom by musing over Guru's teaching.

Day and night she drinks the Name Nectar and kills and casts off her duality.
LTBS: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride meets her True Lord, through the Infinite Love of the Guru. ||2||
Through the infinite love of the Guru, O Nanak the happy wife meets her True Lord.
HHSS: Come, and shower Your Mercy upon me, my most Darling, Dear Beloved.
O my most Darling Beloved shower Yours benediction and pay me a visit.
0ZUC: The soul-bride offers her prayers to You, to adorn her with the True Word of Your Shabad.
The bride supplicated You, to adorn her with the True name.
0Z71: Adorned with the True Word of Your Shabad, she conquers her ego, and as Gurmukh, her affairs are resolved.
Bedecked with the True Name, the bride effaces her ego and through the Guru her affairs are adjusted.
D47J: Throughout the ages, the One Lord is True; through the Guru's Wisdom, He is known.
Throughout all the ages that unique Lord is True and through the Guru given comprehension is He known.
21L6: The self-willed manmukh is engrossed in sexual desire, and tormented by emotional attachment. With whom should she lodge her complaints?
The way-ward wife is engrossed in lust and is tormented by temporal love. Before whom should she go to lodge a complaint?
SCNZ: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest, without the most Beloved Guru. ||3||
Nanak, without the exceedingly favourite Guru the way-ward woman, finds no place of rest.
6U1V: The bride is foolish, ignorant and unworthy. Her Husband Lord is Unapproachable and Incomparable.
The bride is silly, simpleton and meritless. The groom is Unapproachable and Incomprehensible.
FJXG: He Himself unites us in His Union; He Himself forgives us.
Himself the Lord unites in his union and Himself is He the Pardoner.
AKK9: The soul-bride's Beloved Husband Lord is the Forgiver of sins; He is contained in each and every heart.
The bride's dear Spouse is the Pardoner of sins and is contained in every heart.
LANY: The True Guru has made me understand this understanding, that the Lord is obtained through love, affection and loving devotion.
The True Guru has imparted this understanding to me that the Lord is obtained through love. affection, reverential regard and meditation.
P3U8: She remains forever in bliss, day and night; she remains immersed in His Love, night and day.
The bride who night and day remains absorbed in her Lord's love ever, remains happy throughout the twenty-four hours.
XTCQ: O Nanak, that soul-bride who obtains the nine treasures, intuitively obtains her Husband Lord. ||4||3||
Nanak, the wife, who receives the Name's nine treasures, easily obtains God, as her Husband.
7XRU: The sea of Maya is agitated and turbulent; how can anyone cross over this terrifying world-ocean?
The mammon's ocean is mightily agitated; how can the terrible ocean be crossed?
8EMG: Make the Lord's Name your boat, and install the Word of the Shabad as the boatman.
Make Lord's Name the boat and put the Gurbani into it as the boatman.
QD6U: With the Shabad installed as the boatman, the Lord Himself shall take you across. In this way, the difficult ocean is crossed.
When the helmsman of Gurbani is put therein, God Himself takes across. In this way the impassable ocean is crossed.
68MD: The Gurmukh obtains devotional worship of the Lord, and thus remains dead while yet alive.
Through the Guru, Lord devotional service is obtained and like this man remains dead while alive.
3166: In an instant, the Lord's Name erases his sinful mistakes, and his body becomes pure.
In a moment, Lord's Name effaces his sins and his body becomes pure.
9WX3: O Nanak, through the Lord's Name, emancipation is obtained, and the slag iron is transformed into gold. ||1||
Nanak, through Lord's Name emancipation is procured and dross becomes gold.

9AB4: Men and women are obsessed with sex; they do not know the Way of the Lord's Name.
The women and men are engrossed in the pleasures of flesh and know not the way to repeat Lord's Name.
SM0U: Mother, father, children and siblings are very dear, but they drown, even without water.
Mother, father, sons and brothers are very dear, but they drown even without water.
60JY: They are drowned to death without water - they do not know the path of salvation, and they wander around the world in egotism.
They are drowned to death without water, who know not the way to salvation and who through pride wander about the world.
CGKX: All those who come into the world shall depart. Only those who contemplate the Guru shall be saved.
Whosoever are come into the world. they all, shall depart. They, who meditate on the Guru, are saved.
Y5BF: Those who become Gurmukh and chant the Lord's Name, save themselves and save their families as well.
He, who gets resigned to the Guru's will and repeats the Lord's Name, saves himself and saves his lineage as well.
KW7J: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within their hearts; through the Guru's Teachings, they meet their Beloved. ||2||
Nanak, the name abides within his heart and by the Guru's instruction, he meets the Beloved.
W3G1: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is stable. This world is just a drama.
Without the pervading God's Name, nothing is stable. This world is but a play.
ED1J: Implant true devotional worship within your heart, and trade in the Name of the Lord.
Fix firmly true devotion in your heart and deal only in the Lord's Name.
8BEF: Trade in the Lord's Name is infinite and unfathomable. Through the Guru's Teachings, this wealth is obtained.
The trade of Lord's Name is infinite and unfathomable. Through Guru's instruction the wealth of Lord's Name is obtained.
CYDF: This selfless service, meditation and devotion is true, if you eliminate selfishness and conceit from within.
This service, meditation and devotion of yours shall be true, if you shed self conceit from within you.
XD5R: I am senseless, foolish, idiotic and blind, but the True Guru has placed me on the Path.
I am senseless foolish, stupid and blind, The True Guru has put me on the right path.
34G6: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are adorned with the Shabad; night and day, they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
Nanak, the Guru-wards are decorated with God's Name, and night and day sing God's praises.
8SDU: He Himself acts, and inspires others to act; He Himself embellishes us with the Word of His Shabad.
God Himself does and Himself causes others to do. He Himself embellishes man with His Name.
EUBQ: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Shabad; in each and every age, He loves His devotees.
The Lord Himself is the true Guru and Himself the Gurbani. In every age His Saints are dear to Him.
0XAA: In age after age, He loves His devotees; the Lord Himself adorns them, and He Himself enjoins them to worship Him with devotion.
In every age He Himself adorns His Saints, who are sweet to Him. He Himself appoints them to Him devotion.
Q2BJ: He Himself is All-knowing, and He Himself is All-seeing; He inspires us to serve Him.
He Himself is all wise. Himself all seeing. He Himself makes man performs His service.
UWXN: He Himself is the Giver of merits, and the Destroyer of demerits; He causes His Name to dwell within our hearts.
He Himself is the Bestower of merits and destroys demerits. He Himself causes His Name to dwell in man's mind.
727J: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the True Lord, who Himself is the Doer, the Cause of causes. ||4||4||
Nanak, is ever, a sacrifice to the True Lord, who Himself does and causes to do everything.
M4NV: Serve the Guru, O my dear soul; meditate on the Lord's Name.
O my dear, soul, perform you the service of the Guru and meditate on God's Name.
VZQ6: Do not leave me, O my dear soul - you shall find the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being.
O my dear, you are not to get away from me. Receive the Lord while sitting at home.
P3GL: You shall obtain the Lord while sitting within the home of your own being, focusing your consciousness constantly upon the Lord, with true intuitive faith.
By ever fixing your attention on God, with instinctive true faith, you shall obtain Him while abiding in your home.
9RQM: Serving the Guru brings great peace; they alone do it, whom the Lord inspires to do so.
Guru's service is greatly peace bestowing, He alone undertakes it, Whom the Lord Himself causes to perform.
4MEW: They plant the seed of the Name, and the Name sprouts within; the Name abides within the mind.
He sows the Name, the Name sprouts within Him, and the Name he places within his mind.
DCC2: O Nanak, glorious greatness rests in the True Name; It is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny. ||1||
Nanak the greatness is in the True Name. The man receives what is pre-destined for him.
BNDY: The Name of the Lord is so sweet, O my dear; taste it, and focus your consciousness on it.
When you tastest it by fixing your attention, you shall find God's Name Sweet, O my dear.
H6TF: Taste the sublime essence of the Lord with your tongue, my dear, and renounce the pleasures of other tastes.
O mortal, with your tongue taste God's elixir and forsake the relish of other dainties.
P2SA: You shall obtain the everlasting essence of the Lord when it pleases the Lord; your tongue shall be adorned with the Word of His Shabad.
When it pleases God, you shall for aye, attain Lord's Nectar and your tongue shall be adorned with His Name.
PH67: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, a lasting peace is obtained; so remain lovingly focused on the Naam.
He who remembers the Name and keeps his love centered on the Name, attains eternal ease.
N58W: From the Naam we originate, and into the Naam we shall pass; through the Naam, we are absorbed in the Truth.
By Lord's will the mortal is born, by his will he perishes and by His will he merges into Truth.
ARBS: O Nanak, the Naam is obtained through the Guru's Teachings; He Himself attaches us to it. ||2||
Nanak, the Name is obtained by Guru's instruction, With His Name, He Himself attaches.
N0RY: Working for someone else, O my dear, is like forsaking the bride, and going to foreign countries.
This alien service is bad, O Darling. Renouncing the bride you have gone to foreign country.
H1DK: In duality, no one has ever found peace, O my dear; you are greedy for corruption and greed.
In duality none has ever attained ease, O dear. You covets sin and greed.
JQRA: Greedy for corruption and greed, and deluded by doubt, how can anyone find peace?
Those who are deluded by poison and avarice and are gone astray in doubt; how can they obtain peace?
QUTY: Working for strangers is very painful; doing so, one sells himself and loses his faith in the Dharma.
Another's service is very painful. Therein the mortal sells himself and loses his faith.

B4WF: Bound by Maya, the mind is not stable. Each and every moment, it suffers in pain.
Handcuffed by worldly valuables the mind becomes not stable. Every moment pain tortures him.
WQ7A: O Nanak, the pain of Maya is taken away by focusing one's consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
O Nanak only then is the pain of wealth vacated, when man attaches his mind to Gurbani.
G686: The self-willed manmukhs are foolish and crazy, O my dear; they do not enshrine the Shabad within their minds.
Way-ward, stupid and ignorant you are, O my dear soul. God's Name, you enshrinest not within your mind.
KR2L: The delusion of Maya has made them blind, O my dear; how can they find the Way of the Lord?
Owing to mammon's delusion. you have gone blind, O my dear. How can you find God's way?
9ANZ: How can they find the Way, without the Will of the True Guru? The manmukhs foolishly display themselves.
How can you find the way till it pleases not the True Guru? An apostate displays himself.
Z265: The Lord's servants are forever comfortable. They focus their consciousness on the Guru's Feet.
The servants of God are, ever, comfortable. They fix their mind on Guru's feet.
Z6DR: Those to whom the Lord shows His Mercy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.
He to whom God shows mercy ever, sings God's praises.
9CYH: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only profit in this world. The Lord Himself imparts this understanding to the Gurmukh. ||4||5||7||
Nanak, the Name jewel is the only profit in this world. To the Guru-wards the Lord Himself imparts this understanding
HDE3: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is bur One God. By the True Guru's grace He is obtained.
4RD4: My mind has become sad and depressed; how can I see God, the Great Giver?
Within my mind is sadness. How shall I behold my Beneficent Lord?
ZXWH: My Friend and Companion is the Dear Lord, the Guru, the Architect of Destiny.
The honourable, great and the Omnipotent Lord Creator is my Friend and Comrade.
EZWT: The One Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is the Master of the Goddess of Wealth; how can I, in my sadness, meet You?
O the unique Lord, the destiny-scribe and the Lord of the goddess of wealth. How can I the crest-fallen, meet You?
HGFW: My hands serve You, and my head is at Your Feet. My mind, dishonored, yearns for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
My hands perform Yours service my head is on Yours feet, and in my humble mind is the hope to have Your sight.
1UQB: With each and every breath, I think of You, day and night; I do not forget You, for an instant, even for a moment.
For a breath's duration and an instant, I forget You not. Every moment, trice, day and night, I remember You, O Master.
LC6F: O Nanak, I am thirsty, like the rainbird; how can I meet God, the Great Giver? ||1||
Like the pied-cuckoo, Nanak is thirsty for You. How shall he meet his Bounteous Lord?
61MZ: I offer this one prayer - please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord.
I make a supplication, listen to it, O my Beloved Spouse.
E9G0: My mind and body are enticed, beholding Your wondrous play.
My soul and body have been captivated by seeing Yours wonderous plays.
BL6Y: Beholding Your wondrous play, I am enticed; but how can the sad, forlorn bride find contentment?
By beholding Yours wonderous plays I am fascinated. How can I Your sad bride have patience?
HA0Q: My Lord is Meritorious, Merciful and Eternally Young; He is overflowing with all excellences.
My meritorious merciful and ever-young Bridegroom is brimful of all the excellences.
6NKA: The fault is not with my Husband Lord, the Giver of peace; I am separated from Him by my own mistakes.
The fault lies not with my Spouse, the giver of peace. By my own sins, I am separated from Him.
CQW3: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, and return home, O my Beloved Husband Lord. ||2||
Prays Nanak "Be Merciful and return home, O my Beloved Groom".
DFH4: I surrender my mind, I surrender my whole body; I surrender all my lands.
I surrender my soul, I surrender my entire body and surrender I my all the lands.
XCKH: I surrender my head to that beloved friend, who brings me news of God.
I offer my head to that dear friend, who gives me the message of my Lord.
4HWJ: I have offered my head to the Guru, the most exalted; He has shown me that God is with me.
To the Guru of the most exalted station, I have dedicated my head and he has shown the Lord just with me.
Q356: In an instant, all suffering is removed. I have obtained all my mind's desires.
In an instant all the distress of mine is removed and I have obtained all that my mind desired.
9FV4: Day and night, the soul-bride makes merry; all her anxieties are erased.
Day and night, the bride, now, makes merry, and all her anxieties are ended.
WBXL: Prays Nanak, I have met the Husband Lord of my longing. ||3||
Prays Nanak that he has obtained the Spouse of his choice.
6DW7: My mind is filled with bliss, and congratulations are pouring in.
Within my mind is joy and congratulations are pouring in.
PMZS: My Darling Beloved has come home to me, and all my desires have been satisfied.
My darling Beloved has come home and all my thirst is quenched.
M3MP: I have met my Sweet Lord and Master of the Universe, and my companions sing the songs of joy.
I have met my sweet Master the World -Cherisher and my mates sing songs of joy.
MKKS: All my friends and relatives are happy, and all traces of my enemies have been removed.
All my friends and kith and kin are in bliss and the very trace of my arch adversaries is removed.
USPD: The unstruck melody vibrates in my home, and the bed has been made up for my Beloved.
The unbeaten melody resounds in my home and for me and my Beloved a joint bedding is spread.
7TRT: Prays Nanak, I am in celestial bliss. I have obtained the Lord, the Giver of peace, as my Husband. ||4||1||
Prays Nanak, I now reside in celestial bliss. God, the comfort-Bestower Spouse of mine has met me.

X1KX: O Mohan, your temple is so lofty, and your mansion is unsurpassed.
O Sweet-heart, lofty are Yours buildings and unsurpassed Your mansions.
T6ER: O Mohan, your gates are so beautiful. They are the worship-houses of the Saints.
My Enticer, beauteous are Yours gates. They are the places of worship for the Saints.
1AEP: In these incomparable worship-houses, they continually sing Kirtan, the Praises of their Lord and Master.
In Your temple, the Saints, ever, sing the praises of the Infinite and Merciful Lord.
A19C: Where the Saints and the Holy gather together, there they meditate on you.
Where the Saints and holy men assemble, there, they meditate on You.
N0PS: Be Kind and Compassionate, O Merciful Lord; be Merciful to the meek.
Show compassion and kindness, O Merciful Lord, and by king to the meek.
JTES: Prays Nanak, I thirst for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; receiving Your Darshan, I am totally at peace. ||1||
Supplicates Nanak, I am thirsting for a sight of You. By obtaining a view of Yours I receive all the happiness.
LYHU: O Mohan, your speech is incomparable; wondrous are your ways.
O Mohan, beyond-praise is Your speech, and singular is Yours department.
DXZX: O Mohan, you believe in the One. Everything else is dust to you.
O Mohan, you believes in One. All else is as dust to You.
HZW7: You adore the One Lord, the Unknowable Lord and Master; His Power gives Support to all.
You adorest the One incomputable Lord, who, through His Omnipotence is giving support to all the universe.
SNSL: Through the Guru's Word, you have captured the heart of the Primal Being, the Lord of the World.
By Guru's instruction, you have captured the heart of Creator, the Primal Being.
4N93: You Yourself move, and You Yourself stand still; You Yourself support the whole creation.
My Master, Yourself You movest Yourself standest still, and Yourself are supporting the entire structure.
CX9P: Prays Nanak, please preserve my honor; all Your servants seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary. ||2||
Pray Nanak, preserve my honour. All Your slaves seek Yours sanctuary.
KHCG: O Mohan, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, meditates on you; they meditate on the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
O Enchanter, the congregation of Saints meditates on You and thinks of seeing Your sight.
1UWY: O Mohan, the Messenger of Death does not even approach those who meditate on You, at the last moment.
Death's Myrmidon draws not near him, who at the last moment thinks of You, O Fascinator.
PU9P: The Messenger of Death cannot touch those who meditate on You single-mindedly.
Death's Courier touches him not, who with single mind meditates on the Lord.
07RD: Those who worship and adore You in thought, word and deed, obtain all fruits and rewards.
He, who in thought, word and deed remembers You, O Master, obtains all the fruits.
2PCG: Those who are foolish and stupid, filthy with urine and manure, become all-knowing upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
Your, who are filthy like ordure, and urine, silly and stupid, become good divines on seeing Yours sight.
ZT4X: Prays Nanak, Your Kingdom is Eternal, O Perfect Primal Lord God. ||3||
Prays Nanak, O my Omnipresent Lord God, ever-stable is Your sovereignty.
LW6H: O Mohan, you have blossomed forth with the flower of your family.
O Mohan, You have profitable fruition with Your family.
A2B3: O Mohan, your children, friends, siblings and relatives have all been saved.
O Mohan, yours sons, friends, brothers and kith and kin all You have saved.
3KZG: You save those who give up their egotistical pride, upon gaining the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
You have also saved those men, who having a view of You, have shed their ego.
1AUE: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who call you 'blessed'.
Death's Courier draws not near them who call You "Auspicious".
QSXE: Your Virtues are unlimited - they cannot be described, O True Guru, Primal Being, Destroyer of demons.
Infinite are Yours excellences. They cannot be described, O True Guru, the Lord-God.
K4T0: Prays Nanak, Yours is that Anchor, holding onto which the whole world is saved. ||4||2||
Supplicated Nanak, You keepest that prop, by clinging to which the world, is saved.
TPHG: Countless sinners have been purified; I am a sacrifice, over and over again, to You.
Uncountable of sinners, You purifies, O Lord. To You, I am again and again a sacrifice.
THDX: O Nanak, meditation on the Lord's Name is the fire which burns away sinful mistakes like straw. ||1||
Nanak, the fire of Lord's Name's meditation is the burner of the sins straw.
N6N9: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Master of Wealth.
My soul, remember you the Omnipresent Lord God, the Preserve of Universe and the Lord of wealth.
D4S5: Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord, the Destroyer of ego, the Giver of salvation, who cuts away the noose of agonizing death.
My soul, meditate you on Lord, the Enemy of pride, and the granter of salvation, who snaps the noose of the painful death.
322C: Meditate lovingly on the Lotus Feet of the Lord, the Destroyer of distress, the Protector of the poor, the Lord of excellence.
Contemplate over the lotus feet of the Master, who is the Destroyer of distress, Protector of the poor and the Lord of excellence.
R1PD: The treacherous path of death and the terrifying ocean of fire are crossed over by meditating in remembrance on the Lord, even for an instant.
Death's arduous track and the ocean of fire, are crossed by remembering God, for and instant.
1YPL: Meditate day and night on the Lord, the Destroyer of desire, the Purifier of pollution.
Day and night, O Man remember God, who is the Destroyer of desire and the Purifier of pollution.
L0ZV: Prays Nanak, please be Merciful to me, O Cherisher of the world, Lord of the Universe, Lord of wealth. ||1||
Prays Nanak, take pity on me, O You the World-Cherisher, the master of the Universe, and the Lord of wealth.
0BL7: O my mind, remember the Lord in meditation; He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear, the Sovereign Lord King.
O my mind, meditate you on Lord God, the King, who is the Eradicator of anguish and the Destroyer of dread.
G2FA: He is the Greatest Lover, the Merciful Master, the Enticer of the mind, the Support of His devotees - this is His very nature.
By His nature the Merciful Master is the Lover of eminence, the Enchanter of the mind and the Shield of the Saints.

S07F: The Perfect Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He fulfills the desires of the mind.
The perfect Lord is the lover of devotion. From Him mind's desires are obtained.
8CEX: He lifts us up out of the deep, dark pit; enshrine His Name within your mind.
God extricates man from the dark blind well. Enshrine you His Name within your mind.
DMXU: The gods, the Siddhas, the angels, the heavenly singers, the silent sages and the devotees sing Your countless Glorious Praises.
The gods, adepts, God's slaves, heavenly singers, silent sages and Saints sing manifold praises of Yours, O Lord.
51B0: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, O Supreme Lord God, my King. ||2||
Supplicates Nanak, O my sovereign Supreme Lord God show mercy to me.
K6W7: O my mind, be conscious of the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, who wields all power.
My soul remember that Supreme God the Transcendent Lord, who wields all power.
C8BE: He is All-powerful, the Embodiment of compassion. He is the Master of each and every heart;
The Lord is All-powerful and the embodiment of compassion. He is the prop of the life of every heart.
REC9: He is the Support of the breath of life. He is the Giver of the breath of life, of mind, body and soul. He is Infinite, Inaccessible and Unfathomable.
The Infinite, Inaccessible and Illimitable Lord is the Giver of life, mind, body and soul.
40XD: The All-powerful Lord is our Sanctuary; He is the Enticer of the mind, who banishes all sorrows.
The Refugee-protector, All-powerful and the mind enticer banishes all the sorrows.
6R61: All illnesses, sufferings and pains are dispelled, by chanting the Name of the Lord.
All the ailments, lamentations and wickedness are annulled by repeating the Name of the Lord, the Killer of Mur demon.
4C18: Prays Nanak, please be merciful to me, All-powerful Lord; You are the Wielder of all power. ||3||
Prays Nanak, take pity on me, O my All-powerful Lord. All the power is in Yours hands.
9T5Q: O my mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Imperishable, Eternal, Merciful Master, the Highest of all.
My soul, sing, the praises of the immovable, Imperishable and the Merciful Master, who is the Highest of all.
1BU1: The One Lord is the Sustainer of the Universe, the Great Giver; He is the Cherisher of all.
The Lord alone is the Giver and Filler of the World and He cherishes all.
PUF4: The Cherisher Lord is so very merciful and wise; He is compassionate to all.
The most kind and the wise World Nurturer takes pity on all.
A3W3: The pains of death, greed and emotional attachment simply vanish, when God comes to dwell in the soul.
The thorny death avarice and worldly love flee from him in whose mind the Lord abides.
7PEQ: When the Lord is thoroughly pleased, then one's service becomes perfectly fruitful.
He, with whom the Lord is pleased, His service becomes fruitful and toil perfect.
JWLS: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled by meditating on the Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||4||3||
Supplicates Nanak, my desire is fulfilled by contemplating over God, who is kind to the meek.
VNEM: Listen, O my companions: let's join together and make the effort, to surrender to our Husband Lord.
Hear, my mates, let us join and make effort, to reconcile God, our Bridegroom.
UZ0Z: Renouncing our pride, let's charm Him with the potion of devotional worship, and the mantra of the Holy Saints.
By shedding our ego, administering the charm of devotion and saints word, let us fascinate Him.
1MN9: O my companions, when He comes under our power, He shall never leave us again. This is the good nature of the Lord God.
O my mates, once He comes under our power, he shall not, again, forsake us. This is the good custom of the Illustrious Lord.
6P7K: O Nanak, God dispels the fear of old age, death and hell; He purifies His beings. ||1||
Nanak, the Lord destroys the dread of old age, death and hell of that mortal, with whom He is pleased and He purifies him.
KEDD: Listen, O my companions, to my sincere prayer: let's make this firm resolve.
Hear, my companions, to my good supplication. Let us firmly resolve like this.
WCK0: In the peaceful poise of intuitive bliss, violence will be gone, as we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Getting rid of ills, let us naturally sing the songs in praise of the World-Lord.
JYH0: Our pains and troubles shall be eradicated, and our doubts shall be dispelled; we will receive the fruits of our minds' desires.
Our disputes and strifes shall depart, our doubts be dispelled and we shall obtain the heart desired boons.
BYP7: O Nanak, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Supreme Lord God, the Perfect, Transcendent Lord. ||2||
O Nanak, let us meditate on the Name of the Transcendent, Omnipresent and Supreme Lord.
TFQF: O my companions, I yearn for Him continually; I invoke His Blessings, and pray that God may fulfill my hopes.
O my mate, I ever, long for Him and invoke His blessing. May the Lord fulfil my hope.
1R55: I thirst for His Feet, and I long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; I look for Him everywhere.
I thirst for Lord's Feet and long for His sight. I look for Him in all the places.
9CWN: I search for traces of the Lord in the Society of the Saints; they will unite me with the All-powerful Primal Lord God.
God's tracks I will trace in the company of holy men. The saint unites the mortal with the Omnipresent Lord.
95J4: O Nanak, those humble, noble beings who meet the Lord, the Giver of peace, are very blessed, O my mother. ||3||
Nanak, whom the Comfort Bestower Pious Being meets they are very fortunate, O Mother.
74MY: O my companions, now I dwell with my Beloved Husband; my mind and body are attuned to the Lord.
O my mate, I now abide with my Beloved Husband. My Mind and body are domesticated with God.

7CMG: Bavan akhri = the bani of fifty-two letters. Mahla = body. Mahla 5 = Guru Nanak in the fifth body, (the bani of) Guru Arjan Dev.

Gauree, Baavan Akhree ~ The 52 Letters, Fifth Mehl:
Gauri Having Fifty two letters Fifth Guru.

Sri Guru Arjan Dev ji, in Gauri raag, gives teaching through the bani named Bavan Akhri — that is, through fifty-two letters. Although Gurmukhi has thirty-five letters, here fifty-two letters are counted in the Sanskrit way: (33) thirty-three consonants, 16 vowels and three conjunct letters — ksh 1, tr 2, gy 3 — in this way they come to fifty-two. ☬ In this bani the salok is the root, and the pauris are its commentary. At one time Mata Ganga ji wished for jewelled ornaments. For her sake he composed this bani, studded with the jewels of detachment, discernment and the rest, and, knowing it as an ornament for the next world, had Sri Mata Ganga ji learn it by heart; or, of his own wish he composed it for the sake of all Sikhs. At the beginning and at the end two invocations are made; these two are the lids of the box, and within it is the bani, which is the jewelled ornament.

The Divine Guru is the image of peace, truth and wisdom. The Divine Guru is the Philosopher's stone by touching which the mortal is saved.

TC1C: Sabh = all. Harta = the one who removes. Patit = those fallen (into vices), sinners. Pavit kara = the one who makes pure.
